chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:
Do not eat with the left hand while you are able (to eat with the right).
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on eating with the left hand in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) in *Al-Kafi* establishes the normative practice of eating with the right hand as a sign of gratitude and adherence to the Sunnah, while implicitly acknowledging that eating with the left is permissible when necessary. In Shia jurisprudence, this is often classified as *mustahabb* (recommended) rather than obligatory, reflecting the principle of ease in daily rituals. The instruction underscores the integration of spiritual mindfulness into mundane acts, reinforcing the body's alignment with divine favor.
